platform.description: Conversion platform this connector belongs to. Tabs in the Conversion Events UI are scoped by this value. Existing records without a platform default to facebook (for facebook_capi) or other.

filter_verticals.description: JSON array of vertical codes to match against the lead's vertical field. Empty array = match all

filter_brands.description: JSON array of brand names to match. Empty array = match all

filter_suppliers.description: JSON array of supplier names or SIDs to match. Empty array = match all

filter_supplier_types.description: JSON array of supplier types (Internal, External, Calls) to match. Empty array = match all

filter_routes.description: JSON array of lead_route keys (standard, direct, data, event, queue) to match. Empty array = match all processing routes

filter_conditions.description: JSON array of {field, operator, value} conditions evaluated against enriched lead data (including calculated fields). All must match for the connector to fire. Empty = no conditions. Operators: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_empty, is_not_empty

fb_access_token.description: Facebook CAPI access token (masked in UI)

received_event_name.description: Event name fired on the intake trigger, key on_qualified. Falls back to 'Lead' if blank. W2-STATUS: the field name is unchanged so the settings UI keeps working; only the trigger key it answers to was renamed.

sold_event_name.description: Event name fired on the Sold trigger. No fallback — if blank, the Sold event does not fire.

unsold_event_name.description: Event name fired on the Unsold trigger. Falls back to 'Lead' if blank.

queued_event_name.description: Event name fired on the Queued trigger. Falls back to 'Lead' if blank.

dq_event_name.description: Event name fired on the disqualified trigger, key on_disqualified. No fallback: if blank, the disqualified event does not fire.

rejected_event_name.description: Event name fired on the Rejected trigger. Falls back to 'Lead' if blank.

duplicates_event_name.description: Event name fired on the duplicate-rejection trigger, key on_rejected_duplicate. Falls back to 'Lead' if blank. W2-STATUS: the Duplicate status retires into rejected with reason REJECTED_DUPLICATE, and this trigger stays scoped to that reason so a duplicates-only connector does not start firing on every rejection.

auto_hash_capi.description: When true, automatically SHA-256 hashes Meta-required user_data fields (em, ph, fn, ln, ct, st, zp, country, external_id, db, ge) after normalizing. Manual |sha256 transforms on individual tokens are respected and not double-hashed.

headers.description: JSON array of {key, value} header rows

trigger_data_overrides.description: JSON map of trigger_key -> { custom_data field: value } overrides applied on top of the template's custom_data for that trigger. Values support {{token}} placeholders. e.g. {"on_disqualified":{"qualification_status":"Disqualified Lead"}}

triggers.description: JSON array of trigger keys. W2-STATUS, forge-pack/CONTRACT.md D1 and D4 first risk. The canonical keys are on_qualified (intake), on_queued, on_rejected, on_rejected_duplicate, on_disqualified, on_unsold, on_sold, on_returned, on_converted, on_processing_failed, plus any custom inbound lead_status value such as on_24m_lead. Empty array = fire on every lead (intake), gated only by filters. Trigger matching in server/src/functions/processLead.js folds the retired keys onto their canonical names before comparing, so an array written before this migration, or written by a settings screen that has not migrated yet, still fires. A trigger matching nothing throws no error, which is why that dual read exists and why server/src/lib/leadStatus.js findRetiredTriggerKeys is run as a loud check.

triggers_legacy.description: W2-STATUS. The pre-migration triggers array, JSON, written once by the connector trigger remap. Kept so the remap is reversible from the row itself with no backup restore, per the expand-and-contract rollback plan. Never read at runtime.

triggers_migrated_at.description: W2-STATUS. Set when this connector's triggers array was remapped onto the canonical keys. Its presence is what makes the remap idempotent and safely resumable after an interruption.
